the Noah-MP LSM shows the most accurate predictions of the Eurasian winter snow cover in terms of quantitative aspects and spatial patterns.

the importance of the choice of the LSMs in predicting the Eurasia snow.
the intercomparison of four different LSMs, which are coupled to the WRF model, in terms of simulations of the Eurasian winter/spring snow.
the prediction of the Eurasia snow cover using a WRF model coupled with four different land surface models.

the choice of the LSM is an essential factor in predicting Eurasian snow cover.

the Noah-MP LSM is recommended to use for predicting the Eurasian Snow.

the Noah-MP LSM can be used as a reliable tool for predicting the Eurasian Snow.

the Noah-MP LSM should be considered in the global/regional models to predict the winter and spring snow cover in the Eurasia.
